{{Quote|Blast! You scared them away...The gankerz. This one is hungry.|[[Saba Sebatyne]], to Leia|<ref name="Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>}}
'''Gankers''' were creatures that hid in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] vents. Typically, a starship was regularly gassed to eliminate the vermin. [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] went into the vents of the [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']] when she was hungry for one, but [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] scared them off.
